summary: Implemented the Tabs feature but did not run any tests, as instructed. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, TabsRenderable, Tabs with keyboard handling, click action range_clicked, and an animated underline driven by a watcher on _active_tab_name); UnderlineBar gained clickable_ranges (one Text object, click spans last, early path without click spans); Opacity now merges the blended color into the existing style so meta is preserved; docs/reference/tabs.md; sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css; CHANGELOG entry; new tests in tests/renderables/test_underline_bar.py, tests/renderables/test_opacity.py (appended), and tests/widgets/test_tabs.py. The layout resolver was left unchanged because Edge already defines min_size. Choices made: bar position uses the displayed-tab index of the active name, next and previous skip same-name duplicates, and letter search applies only to single-character keys. Known limitations: an empty-label tab gets a flexible zero-width label edge, and a tab name containing ')' cannot be parsed by the action regex. Nothing was committed.
